notes.title: PRAG v9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11634944/8a6b3bfb6df7bb637ed3500f72c4b30af62875ee.gif[/img]

This update brings a number of small fixes and changes.

The most important are:

- levels can now be restarted faster (by holding "down")
- to finish the game, you no longer need all the keys, but you need at least 5 to unlock the next zone.
